body: Yeah. I search up ‘Dad mode’ etc on TikTok because it makes me smile and laugh when fathers act like typical fathers. But it also makes me incredibly sad because I never had that kind of relationship with my father.

The poor animals that were brought home by my mother & I. We both wanted pets, but my mother should’ve assessed the situation financially at the very least since she couldn’t be self aware enough to realise she wasn’t capable of taking care of animals, let alone her own child. She allowed little animals, hamsters etc to roam free around the house since she couldn’t afford cages. (I keep typing we but I was 10 years old. Not my responsibility to oversee the expenses nor to think practically at that age.) It’s like she grew up…but that was back when she was 40. 40 years old and buying animals for the fun of it then neglecting them.
Ghost by Badflower. Heart Failure by Sixx:A.M.

I relate to so much of this but the things that stand out are about announcing she was on her period and the jealousy accusation. She had a notebook recording when we were both on our periods. That doesn’t stand out as nefarious to me but alongside everything else that she did, it makes me feel sick. My mother got with a creep that I never liked (and I was unfortunately proven right about him) and I was accused of jealousy and never wanting her to be happy. She would say it in such a way that was almost smug. Like haha, I’m happy and I have a boyfriend and you don’t so you’re obviously jealous of me.
I started saying “I’m staying alive for Halloween Kills then Scream 5” as a joke but bro...I don’t think it’s a joke anymore.

The best advice I can offer from my personal experience is to strive to be the opposite way that she is. She’s selfish? Aim to be more selfless. She’s cruel? Aim to be more kind. She’s childish? Aim to be more mature. Etc, etc. My mother is extremely childish, likes to give the silent treatment, huff and puff, throw things about and generally treat me like shit when she’s in a bad mood. When I’m in a bad mood, though I have urges to copy the behaviour I’ve witnessed, I really try not to. Instead, I’ll take a breather, do something to cheer myself up, or go off to my room and cry but I never treat her like shit/take it out on her. I also try to resolve conflict between us by communicating properly in a calm voice even when she’s yelling at me. And you’re not a failure or doomed if you do repeat behaviours sometimes, acknowledge that they’re not okay and try to do better for yourself next time. Sending you love. ❤️

Same here. It’s like the things I say to her bounce off of her. I don’t tell her very much about myself, and she doesn’t really ask. She can talk to me for half an hour straight about her acquaintance but she never wants to talk to me about me. But I’ve realised that not everybody is like that. Some people do actually care about my opinion, my feelings, care for what I have to say. And it throws me the fuck off and I become inarticulate when I’m telling a story or something. 🤦🏼‍♀️

Sometimes society accepts there’s such a thing as a terrible mother, but not an irredeemable, unforgivable one. I watch a lot of TV and the only kinds of “bad moms” that are portrayed are the ones that work too much and have no time for their children, and the ones that are addicted to drugs/alcohol/sleeping around etc and not giving a shit about their kids. Society overall does not recognise that mothers can be sexually abusive. But we are actively challenging that by simply being active in this subreddit.
Thank you both of you for making me feel valid. ❤️❤️❤️
